sentences.text: Stenosteus is an extinct genus of medium-sized selenosteid arthrodire placoderms, a group of armored fish. It belongs to the family Selenosteidae within the clade Aspinothoracidi.
The estimated skull length of this animal ranges from 6 to 9 centimeters.
The genus Stenosteus was first described by Dean in 1901.
Fossils of Stenosteus have been found in the Upper Famennian Cleveland Shale of Ohio.
Most known fossils consist of scraps of armor and portions of tooth plates.
Stenosteus lived during the Famennian stage, between 372.15 and 358.86 million years ago.
